description: This Java source file defines the AmqpPublisherActor class responsible for creating JMS MessageProducers and sending ExternalMessages as JMSMessages over AMQP, managing producer cache, handling backoff, and integrating with Akka streams and actors.

classes.name: AmqpPublisherActor
classes.description: Final class responsible for managing JMS MessageProducers, sending ExternalMessages as JMSMessages, handling producer cache, backoff, and integrating with Akka streams and actors.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Akka Props configuration for AmqpPublisherActor with connection, session, and connection configuration.

methods.name: shouldPublishAcknowledgement
methods.description: Determines if an acknowledgement should be published based on its label.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes static target producers and handles startup logic.

methods.name: preEnhancement
methods.description: Sets up message handling for ProducerClosedStatusReport and start producer commands.

methods.name: handleProducerClosedStatusReport
methods.description: Handles closed producer reports, triggers backoff if not already in backoff mode.

methods.name: handleStartProducer
methods.description: Resets backoff mode and creates static target producers.

methods.name: createStaticTargetProducers
methods.description: Creates producers for static targets without placeholders.

methods.name: toPublishTarget
methods.description: Converts an address string to an AmqpTarget object.

methods.name: createTargetProducer
methods.description: Creates a MessageProducer for a given destination, handles exceptions.

methods.name: findByValue
methods.description: Finds map entries with a specific MessageProducer value.

methods.name: backOff
methods.description: Enters backoff mode and triggers backoff actor.

methods.name: postEnhancement
methods.description: No operation (noop).

methods.name: publishMessage
methods.description: Publishes a message asynchronously if not in backoff mode, otherwise fails.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Creates a new message context for publishing, with or without a producer.

methods.name: newContextWithProducer
methods.description: Creates a message context with a valid producer, handling send completion and exceptions.

methods.name: newContextWithoutProducer
methods.description: Creates a context for failed message due to missing producer.

methods.name: handleQueueOfferResult
methods.description: Handles the result of offering a message to the source queue.

methods.name: toAcknowledgement
methods.description: Converts a Signal into an Acknowledgement, with optional auto-ack target.

methods.name: getMessageSendingException
methods.description: Creates a MessageSendingFailedException from a message and exception.

methods.name: getBackOffModeError
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating producer is in backoff mode.

methods.name: toJmsMessage
methods.description: Converts ExternalMessage to JMS Message, setting properties and wrapping.

methods.name: getProducer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a MessageProducer for a destination, maintaining cache.

methods.name: tryToCreateProducer
methods.description: Attempts to create a MessageProducer, returns null on failure.

methods.name: createProducer
methods.description: Creates a new MessageProducer for a destination.

methods.name: maintainReplyToMap
methods.description: Maintains the producer cache size by removing oldest entries.

methods.name: closeCachedProducer
methods.description: Closes a cached MessageProducer.

methods.name: jmsExceptionToString
methods.description: Converts a JMSException to a string representation.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cleans up resources, shuts down kill switch, and closes producers.
